text.zh_CN: 将物品放入工作台后，它会自动开始分解；进度条结束时消耗一个物品，有一半几率得到物品包含的一种完整要素，包括复合要素。点击领取要素后，工作台会继续处理下一件物品。
text.en_US: Insert an item to start deconstruction automatically. After the progress bar completes, one item is consumed and there is a 50% chance of obtaining one whole aspect, including a compound aspect. Claim it before the table processes the next item.
